name: CRITICAL WARNING: Dutch Bros Rebel Energy Drinks (Taurine, Carbonation & Sugar)

whyItWorks: EMERGENCY CLINICAL TRIGGER: Combines high doses of taurine, glucuronolactone, synthetic caffeine, extreme carbonation, artificial Blue 1 dyes, and up to 80g of high-fructose corn syrup. Sparks violent colonic motor contractions, intense gas pressure, and mucosal bleeding.
prepOrOrderInstructions: NEVER consume Dutch Bros Rebel energy drinks if you have IBD. Stick to decaf hot teas.
